# miniz inflate dependency

Source: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz

Pinned revision: `2c50092b3a4010760df02e7842960abdc3f25ee3`.
The six upstream C/header files and LICENSE are copied unchanged. Only the
locally generated static-export header is added. The project wrapper disables
heap allocation, compression, ZIP and zlib compatibility APIs. MIT notices
are retained. This dependency does not implement USB or board support.
